modules.name: TypeOCore
modules.description: The core TypeO game framework. Provides the game loop, entities, scenes, services, contents and the base APIs every other module builds on.

modules.name: TypeOBasic2d
modules.description: 2D building blocks for TypeO games: 2D entities, drawables, sprites and scene primitives.

modules.name: TypeODesktop
modules.description: Desktop platform support: window management, keyboard and mouse hardware and input services.

modules.name: TypeOTK
modules.description: OpenTK based rendering backend: OpenGL canvas, shaders, textures and font rendering.

modules.name: TypeD
modules.description: The TypeDitor editor framework. Provides the models, hooks, views and APIs that editor (dev) module projects extend TypeDitor with.
